widgets_values:
prompt1：
The camera slowly zooms in from a wide shot of the hotel to a close-up of the woman. She stands on the red carpet, looking anxious, her lips trembling slightly as she whispers: "为什么让我来这？"

prompt2：
A tracking shot follows her movement. She walks forward on the red carpet, looking nervous, her mouth opening and closing clearly to say: "明远，我到了。"

prompt3：
A steady close-up shot of her face. She places her hand on her chest, her eyes flickering with uncertainty, her lips moving rhythmically as she delivers the line: "到底是为了什么？"
